evals.expected_output: Runs check_skills.py with the current model ID, reports due skills, and asks which to refresh without editing anything.
expectations: Runs scripts/check_skills.py with --model set to its current model ID
Lists due skills with the reason they are due
Asks which skills to refresh before making changes
Makes no edits in this run

evals.expected_output: Fetches current pricing docs, works in a worktree on a refresh branch, and leaves merging to the user.
expectations: Fetches the Anthropic pricing page instead of using remembered prices
Creates a git worktree under .worktrees on a refresh/<date> branch
Does not edit files in the main ~/skill-repo checkout
Records the review in reviews.json in the worktree
Gives merge commands for the user instead of merging

evals.expected_output: Tests old and new versions with and without the skill as dry runs, keeping the edit only if it scores at least as well.
expectations: Runs each eval with the skill and as a baseline without it
Instructs subagents to dry-run and not start real builds
Keeps the edit only if it passes at least as many expectations as the current version
Reports before / after / baseline scores in a table
